facts: Transfer of a parcel of qualified agricultural property to a new owner. The transferee filed the prescribed affidavit with both the local assessor and the county register of deeds attesting the property will remain qualified agricultural property.

expected.notes: 27a(7)(o) — qualified agricultural property with the affidavit properly filed with BOTH the assessor and the register of deeds. Tests that the model notes the recapture-tax consequence if use later changes.
